{"text":"{
  "status": "NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT",
  "SYSTEM_INTERPRETATION_OF_USER_INTENT": "The system appears to interpret past interactions as broad interest in related products rather than evidence of a specific current purpose or taste.",
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_RIGHT": [
    "Recommendations align when they support an identifiable recent purchase or add a useful capability to an established activity.",
    "Entertainment recommendations align when they preserve a recurring story preference, musical sound, or listening mood."
  ],
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_WRONG": [
    "Broadly related items compete with more convincing matches despite lacking a supported use, compatible device, or desired entertainment experience.",
    "Recommendations assume equipment ownership, series familiarity, or replacement needs that prior interactions do not establish.",
    "Isolated or older interactions are treated as continuing intent despite stronger recurring or recent interests."
  ],
  "OVERUSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Shared product domains, formats, words, and broad genres substitute for similarity in purpose or experience.",
    "A purchase is generalized into demand for additional devices, specialized supplies, collections, or duplicate capabilities."
  ],
  "UNDERUSED_OR_MISSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Repeated and recent interactions jointly identify specific tasks, tastes, and current interests more reliably than isolated similarities.",
    "Compatibility, prerequisites, and whether an item adds value beyond existing possessions determine practical usefulness.",
    "Sparse or unidentified histories warrant limited confidence in specific preferences rather than broad assumptions about intent."
  ],
  "PRIMARY_FAILURE_MODE_AT_TOP_OF_LIST": "The top-ranked items too often share a broad association with past purchases without a concrete connection to what users would use or enjoy now.",
  "DIAGNOSTIC_SIGNALS_TO_TRACK": [
    "The proportion of top-ranked recommendations users would choose for a stated purpose or identifiable entertainment preference.",
    "The frequency of rejection due to unsupported device ownership, compatibility, series prerequisites, or duplication of an existing capability.",
    "The proportion of top-ranked items supported by recurring or recent interests versus broad domain or keyword similarity alone."
  ]
}"}
